name: Lone Wolf Nano
source:
Welcome to the end of the world, and the story of one lost wolf. Our protagonist, codenamed Nano, is but one among many 'gifted' individuals wandering through what once was a city full of people. But something happened... something unexplainable... And what followed... may be even worse... 

Can you really trust people you've just met? Should you even try to evade the danger if it's only a matter of time?

[From [url=https://shibakita.itch.io/lone-wolf-nano]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到世界末日，以及一只迷失的狼的故事。我们的主角，代号为Nano，只是在这座曾经挤满了人的城市中徘徊的众多“有天赋”的人之一。但发生了一些事情……一些无法解释的事情……而接下来的事情……可能更糟…… 

你真的能信任你刚认识的人吗？如果这只是时间问题，你还应该尝试逃避危险吗？

[来自[url=https://shibakita.itch.io/lone-wolf-nano]Itch.io[/url]]
